description: Renovate updates Swift packages only. GitHub Actions are Dependabot's job (.github/dependabot.yml), so the two never open the same pull request.

packageRules.description: Minor and patch updates: one weekly pull request.
Major updates get their own pull request and need approval on the Dependency Dashboard.
stasel/WebRTC versions follow Chromium milestones (157.0.0, 158.0.0, ...), so every release is a major. Treat them as routine updates instead of waiting for approval.
